If I delete the app, are my records still there?
No. Deleting the app deletes the records on your phone too. Before deleting, tap “Export” and save a “Full backup”.
What do I do when I get a new phone?
If you move your whole phone over with iCloud Backup or a computer, Xiaoman’s records come along. You can also “Export” a full backup on the old phone and “Import” it on the new one.
How often should I back up?
We suggest exporting once a month, or before switching or resetting your phone. Exporting and restoring are free.
